release_notes: Bugfix release. Fixed: the Affiliate Networks page crashed with "canWriteResource is not defined" since v1.4.0 (issue #7) — the page loads again for everyone, and every mutation control (create, edit, delete, bulk delete) now respects the user's network write permission. Fixed: System Status warnings and recommendations ("Critically low disk space!") were hardcoded in Russian regardless of the panel language — they are now localized in all 7 languages.
